newsitem.title: USA: Motorola Q4 total sales rise five percent.
newsitem.headline: Motorola Q4 total sales rise five percent.

text.p: Motorola Inc on Thursday said total sales in the fourth quarter rose five percent to $7.69 billion from $7.30 billion in the same period a year ago.

Revenue generated by its General Systems Segment rose 17 percent to $3.3 billion, as orders climbed 21 percent and operating profits were higher. The segment accounted for 36 percent of Motorola's sales in 1995.

In the Semiconductor Products Segment, fourth-quarter sales fell 18 percent to $1.9 billion and orders dropped 11 percent. The segment had an operating loss versus a profit in the same period of 1995.
In its Messaging, Information and Media Segment, Motorola said sales declined 17 percent to $876 million, while orders were 24 percent lower.

The segment recorded an operating loss compared with a profit in the year-ago period. The shortfall reflected the sales decline, pricing pressures in the modem business, and restructuring and other charges.
In its Land Mobile Products Segment, sales increased 26 percent to $1.3 billion, orders were 26 percent higher, and operating profits improved.

In the Automotive, Energy and Components Sector, sales rose five percent and orders were five percent higher. Operating profits were lower because of continuing pricing pressures in the components and energy-products businesses, and restructuring and other charges.
In the Space and Systems Technology Group, sales increased 75 percent, orders were 18 percent lower and operating profits rose.
